title: GTA 6 Gameplay Leaks Are Back with Potentially Big Spoilers

Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA Leaks GTA 6 Gameplay Leaks Are Back with Potentially Big Spoilers 25 minutes of gameplay leaked online by Liam Croft 8 hours ago Share: Cyberleek, the GTA 6 leaker from before the Netflix Extended Look debuted, has returned to the Internet with yet another significant gameplay video that potentially reveals a lot of spoilers and details Rockstar is yet to officially share. The leaker has uploaded another 25 minutes of gameplay taken from a development build of GTA 6. Just in case you don't want to see any potential spoilers, the article continues after the image. The big thing to come out of this leaked gameplay is GTA 6 might actually have a first-person mode. In the footage, Jason is seen driving different cars from a first-person perspective. At one point, he gets out of a car and enters the open world, and continues playing in first-person. Rockstar hasn't commented on or confirmed a first-person mode being in GTA 6 at launch, and this footage is taken from a dev build of the game. It's possible this makes it into the final game, but as this isn't official video put out by the developer, don't take it as confirmation. The other thing is...errmm...the entire section featuring Jason has the character completely naked. Related Articles News GTA 6 Gameplay Leaker Has an Actual Build of the Game, Still Posting Leaks Update #3: Leaker proves they have the game in some form News Rockstar Issues Statement on GTA 6 Leaks, Apologises for How Long Gameplay Reveal Has Taken "We are very sorry that everything has taken as long as it has" There is full nudity out in the open world, but again, this isn't a final version of the game. Those speculating and debating the gameplay clips have made suggestions that this won't be allowed in the full version come 19th November. Lucia is also seen later in the leaked footage, and she's wearing just a bikini the entire time. Elsewhere in the gameplay video, a sequence where you're introduced to off-road dirt biking, complete with a cutscene and gameplay. We know there are races in the game, so you may be competing on dirt bikes. In response to the first round of leaks from the person in question, Rockstar apologised for how long it had taken for it to debut official gameplay and shared its "heartbreak" over the leaked clips. At the time, it hadn't yet shown the Extended Look video on Netflix.
